findings.title: Subdomain Hijacking on Abandoned Cloud Assets
findings.description: Detection of several dangling CNAME records pointing to decommissioned third-party cloud services, potentially allowing attackers to take control of legitimate shopify.com subdomains.

findings.title: Critical Vulnerability in Third-Party App via API
findings.description: A popular third-party application integrated with Shopify was found to contain a high-severity vulnerability permitting unauthorized access to merchant data.

attack_scenarios.title: Subdomain Hijacking for Phishing
attack_scenarios.narrative: Attacker identifies a dangling CNAME record (e.g., test.shopify.com) pointing to an unclaimed Azure instance. Attacker claims the instance, hosts a perfect replica of the Shopify admin login page on test.shopify.com, and sends phishing emails to merchants to harvest credentials.

mitigations: Perform continuous DNS auditing to proactively identify and remove dangling CNAME records.
Implement stricter security vetting and continuous monitoring of third-party applications in the Shopify App Store.
